sections.title: The short version
sections.summary: Open or start a set in the Library via the Regex sets chip then Sets view for rule count and one-line read of each set; open existing, click New set, or drop a file to start blank on the Workbench. Add a rule with New rule; pick a starter recipe among 37 each with real Before After or Start blank; either opens ready to edit. Write find and replace: pick Guided Plain words or Pattern mode; fill Find and Replace with; leave Replace empty to remove the match. Under Where it runs turn on pipeline stages this rule should act on such as user input model output display. Try then save: Quick try beside the rule runs it alone on a sample line; open the full test bench to watch the whole set as a chain; then Save or Ctrl Cmd S.

sections.title: Three ways to write a rule
sections.summary: Every rule is one find pattern one replacement and a list of phases. The three modes view the same fields so switching never loses work. Guided never shows the pattern; it asks what to catch what it becomes and where it runs; examples build the pattern and show one honest miss that it only knows words you showed; escape link hands off to Pattern. Plain words offers Match these words with comma list and tune grid plus plain English pattern and hit chips, or Match by example with two to five phrases detecting shared structure. Pattern is raw Find and flags with live In words reading; undescribable forms say so instead of guessing. Empty Replace with removes the match. Where it runs uses phase pills from Write for; foreign phases show dashed not vanish. Fine print holds depth window re-run macros character filter first-match only draw-over and Only run after.

sections.title: Order, and how to check it
sections.summary: Rules run top to bottom in list order; each sees text the prior left so earlier wins when two compete for the same text. Full Health check runs the real chain on execution-verified examples; never-fires shadowing is flagged in plain words; exact duplicates get one-click Fix off; shadowed rules stay for your reorder judgment. Only run after sequences two by fired or not without moving either. No drag-to-reorder yet; new and imported land at bottom; Duplicate inserts after original; to run earlier delete and re-add. Quick try runs one rule alone on a sample. Full test bench steps every rule with word diff capture chips or skip reason ending in What comes out. Import preview checks a rival file against your sample before import; SillyTavern dialect today others not wired. Bench Escape a literal works; Pattern-mode Find Escape button is still a placeholder.

sections.title: Tips
sections.summary: Start from a recipe: New rule opens 37 starters in Cleanup Guardrails Formatting Style Compatibility Roleplay; every Before After is engine-computed not hand-written. Empty Replace with removes the match. Two rules can shadow without either being wrong; let the full check find it. Prefer Only run after before workarounds.
